common.networkError: No connection. Check the internet and try again.
common.genericError: Something went wrong. Try again in a minute.
common.validation: Check the form — something is filled in incorrectly.
common.notFoundGroup: This group no longer exists. It may have been archived.

home.emptyBody: You can’t add children yourself — parents own the profile. Send parents an invitation; their children appear here once they sign up and grant you access.
home.e1: Send a parent your invitation link or code
home.e2: The parent adds their child and grants access until the end of the school year with one switch
home.e3: From the second wave on, you see each child’s progress
home.emptyNote: Parents are notified about the access and can withdraw it at any time.
home.groupsBody: Children appear in a group’s overview — progress, common mistakes, who hasn’t taken the wave. Create your first group, then add children to it.
home.loadErrorBody: The connection dropped. Try again — nothing you did is lost.
home.inactiveTitle: Your teacher cabinet is closed right now
home.inactiveBody: Check your application’s status — the cabinet opens once it is approved.

create.title: Create a group
create.sub: A group is just for you — parents and children don’t see it.
create.gradeHint: A group with a grade takes only children of that grade and shows that grade’s waves.
create.existed: You already have a group with this name — opening it.

group.subOpen: Wave {n} closes on {date} · {took} of {total} children have taken it
group.subClosed: Wave {n} closed on {date} · {took} of {total} children took it
group.subNone: There are no monitoring waves for this group’s grade yet.
group.gainSub: Sorted by progress, not level: level shows who you recruited, progress shows what your teaching did. Select a child for details.
group.noteNoCompare: Progress appears once two waves have been measured.
group.notePositions: Positions and percentiles stay with parents; you see progress.
group.noteOwn: Your own child isn’t included here.
group.mSub: From the wrong answers children picked. Select one to build your next lesson.
group.mCta: Build a practice set from this
group.mCtaNote: Opens in practice mode — it never affects a child’s position.
group.mEmpty: No common mistakes yet — they appear once children have taken this wave.
group.missSubOpen: Reminders go to parents, never to children. The wave is open until {date}.
group.missSubClosed: Wave {n} is closed — reminders are no longer sent.
group.missNone: Everyone in the group has taken wave {n}.
group.toast: Parents reminded by SMS: {n}. Children don’t receive anything.
group.toastAlready: Already reminded today: {n} — one reminder per child per day, from anyone.
group.errNoOpenWave: The wave has closed — reminders can’t be sent any more.
group.emptyBody: Add children who have granted you access — use “Add children” below.
group.ungrouped: Children not in any group: {n}. You can add them below.
group.loadErrorBody: The connection dropped. Try again — reminders you’ve already sent are saved.

manage.title: Manage the group
manage.sub: Rename it, add or remove children, or archive it. Children keep their access either way.
manage.removed: {name} is no longer in the group.
manage.addSub: Children in {grade} who granted you access.
manage.skipped: Not added: {n} — a different grade, or the access has ended.
manage.addNone: Every child you can see in this grade is already here.
manage.archiveBody: The group disappears from your list. Children keep their access and their results; you can create a new group at any time.

pupil.accessOwn: Your own child — your access as a parent doesn’t expire.
pupil.latestSub: Wave {n} compared with the wave before
pupil.noScore: No scores or item-by-item answers — only progress and how it changed.
pupil.ownNote: This is your own child: the full parent report, including the position, opens in your family view.
pupil.loadError: We couldn’t load this child’s details.
pupil.notFoundTitle: This child isn’t visible to you
pupil.notFoundBody: The parent may have withdrawn the access, or it has ended. You only see children whose parents opened access to you.

kids.title: My children
kids.sub: Same account, different view. Here you’re a parent.
kids.body: You see the full parent report here, including {name}’s position — exactly what any parent sees for their own child.
kids.note: Your access as a parent doesn’t expire: the profile is yours. Your access as a tutor to other children ends with the school year.
kids.coiSub: Applied automatically, so there’s never a reason to help your own child.
kids.coi1: {name} isn’t counted in your group statistics.
kids.coi1Many: Your children aren’t counted in your group statistics.
kids.coi2: {name} is left out of your teacher bonus calculation.
kids.coi2Many: They’re left out of your teacher bonus calculation.
kids.coi3: You can’t invigilate an in-person final that {name} is taking.
kids.coi3Many: You can’t invigilate an in-person final that your child is taking.
kids.coi4: For your pupils, you only see what their parents opened to you.
kids.emptyTitle: No children of your own here
kids.emptyBody: If you’re also a parent, add your child in the family workspace with your own account. They appear here, apart from your pupils, and their full report opens from this page.
